mapper.select: select oa.id as id, oa.org_id as orgId, oa.dentist_id as dentistId, oa.patient_id as patientId, oa.appoint_item_id as appointItemId, oa.open_id as openId, oai.name as appointItemName, oa.appoint_content as appointContent, date_format(oa.appoint_date,'%Y-%m-%d') as appointDate, date_format(oa.appoint_time, '%H:%i' ) as appointTime, oa.duration as duration, oa.patient_name as patientName, oa.patient_phone as patientPhone, oa.status as status, date_format(oa.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d') as crtTime, a.id as appointmentId, a.confirm_status as confirmStatus from online_appointment oa left join appointment a on a.online_appointment_id = oa.id and a.inservice = true left join online_appoint_item oai on oai.item_id = oa.appoint_item_id where oa.id = #{id}
select count(oa.id) from online_appointment oa where oa.org_id = #{orgId} and oa.status = 0 and oa.inservice = 1

SELECT date_format(a.appoint_time,'%H:%i') as time, count(a.id) as `count` FROM `online_appointment` a where DATE_FORMAT(a.appoint_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d') and a.org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY a.appoint_time ASC
